def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hdiv=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]
    vdiv=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=bg]
    if not hdiv: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    hc=grid[hdiv[0]][0]
    hs=[r for r in hdiv if grid[r][0]==hc]
    vs=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==hc for r in range(h) if r not in hs)]
    if not vs: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    rb=[-1]+hs+[h]; cb=[-1]+vs+[w]
    bands=[(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
    panels=[(cb[i]+1,cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1)]
    src=max(((ri,ci) for ri in range(len(bands)) for ci in range(len(panels))),
            key=lambda z:sum(v!=bg and v not in (hc,hc) for row in grid[bands[z[0]][0]:bands[z[0]][1]] for v in row[panels[z[1]][0]:panels[z[1]][1]]))
    (ra,rz),(ca,cz)=bands[src[0]],panels[src[1]]
    motif=[row[ca:cz] for row in grid[ra:rz]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b in bands:
        for x,y in panels:
            if (a,b)==bands[src[0]] and (x,y)==panels[src[1]]: continue
            for r in range(a,b):
                for c in range(x,y): out[r][c]=motif[(r-a)%len(motif)][(c-x)%len(motif[0])]

def transform(grid):
    # Separators of one color divide the grid into panels. The source panel is
    # the panel with the most non-background cells; repeat its pattern in all
    # other panels, tiled from each panel's top-left corner.
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Detect continuous full-length uniform separator rows/columns.
    rows=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=bg]
    def segments(n, cuts):
        out=[]; start=0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start<cut: out.append((start,cut))
            start=cut+1
        if start<n: out.append((start,n))
        return out
    rs=segments(h,rows); cs=segments(w,cols)
    panels=[]
    for a,b in rs:
      for x,y in cs:
        area=sum(v!=bg for r in range(a,b) for v in grid[r][x:y])
        panels.append((area,a,b,x,y))
    _,sa,sb,sx,sy=max(panels)
    motif=[row[sx:sy] for row in grid[sa:sb]]
    mh,mw=len(motif),len(motif[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for _,a,b,x,y in panels:
      if (a,b,x,y)==(sa,sb,sx,sy): continue
      for r in range(a,b):
        for c in range(x,y): out[r][c]=motif[(r-a)%mh][(c-x)%mw]
    return out
